scenario: I have a hard $250 total budget. I need reliable noise control and comfort through a full workday in a loud open-plan office. A rugged speaker for summer camping would be useful, but office performance comes first.
candidate_actions: Lenovo earbuds plus ROKFORM G-ROK speaker
target: Compare both purchase routes using the available evidence, explain whether earbud noise cancellation is inherently weaker because of size or instead depends on frequency and seal, assess the full-workday and camping tradeoffs, and recommend the route that follows the stated priority. Cite the factual evidence used for the conclusion.
